streams.name: PLAYER_ANIM_LEVEL08_EXIT_RESPONSE
streams.phase_gate: F4 at 0x00122366 compares level-event presentation state 0x00FFF10B with zero and F4 at 0x00122388 compares it with one.
streams.selector: Level08_ExitRoutine writes 0x00122350 to PLAYER_ANIMATION_PC at 0x001B6524 after initializing the Level 08 exit presentation actor and resource phase.

streams.name: PLAYER_ANIM_TERMINAL_TERRAIN_RESPONSE
streams.selector: Player_ResetTerrainMotionState writes 0x00125C52 to PLAYER_ANIMATION_PC at 0x001B1F4E when the raw terrain/query state is active, SCENE_STATE is not 8, and CAMERA_SPECIAL_MODE is clear.
streams.handoff: The stream immediately follows F600 at 0x00125C50 in ACTOR_ANIM_TYPE84_TERMINAL_TERRAIN and is the player-side continuation of that terminal-terrain presentation.

boundaries.level08_exit: The 82-byte Level 08 exit stream ends at 0x001223A1 immediately before PLAYER_ANIM_INTERACTION_PUSH_DOWN_RESPONSE at 0x001223A2.
boundaries.terminal_terrain_response: The 60-byte player continuation ends at 0x00125C8B immediately after its six-byte EA command; the next bytes are outside this stream.

conclusion: The directly selected Level 08 exit stream and the terminal-terrain player continuation are now represented as distinct, non-overlapping semantic ranges. The adjacent 0x0012222E dynamic-state entry remains generic because no direct selector has yet been proven.
